The node appears less about branded consumer demand and more about channel density, contractor access, installation labor, replacement cycles, private-label or category-management relationships, and pro-distribution scale. The reference lane includes Watsco as a clear HVAC/R distribution leader. The underfollowed lane prioritizes Hillman Solutions, Installed Building Products, and Builders FirstSource because they sit inside hardware merchandising, installation, building-products distribution, or pro-channel supply rather than obvious consumer-discretionary screens.
